name: Experiments in Solid and Fluid Mechanics
description: Measurement techniques in solid and fluid mechanics, conducting experiments related to fundamental concepts in solid and fluid mechanics, conducting experiments related to engineering applications in solid and fluid mechanics. Laboratory: performance characteristics of free jet, study of flow measurements devices, fully developed flow through pipes, performance characteristics of Pelton turbine, flow visualization, flow around circular cylinder, Bernoulli equation experiment, submerged jet experiment, development of turbulent pipe flow, performance characteristics of centrifugal pump, hardness testing, strain gauge, uniaxial tension, uniaxial compression, torsion, impact (Izod), impact (Charpy), and buckling.
